apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Games on free-to-air show as live as soon as the TV coverage starts, so they're on Home before kick-off. Listings in other languages are hidden.

New look: big picture tiles for games and sports, and a full-width feature at the top of Home and Movies. Wrestling added (WWE Raw, NXT, PPV events, WWE Network). Continue watching now follows you between your devices on the same TorBox account, and long-press a show to pick an episode.
